name: Hmong mustard soup
summary: A northwest mustard-green soup with a sharp, slightly bitter taste, served beside fried stream fish.
seoTitle: Canh cai meo in Mai Chau — mustard soup with fried fish
seoDescription: Canh cải mèo is a sharp, slightly bitter mustard-green soup, served with fried stream fish in the Thai houses of Mai Châu.
